data.name: Pompiers Simulator
data.detailed_description:
🚒 The Game

You’re not a firefighter, but you’ve always wanted to experience the intensity of a real emergency medical response?
Pompiers Simulator puts you in the shoes of a first responder, right in the heart of rescue missions, in a simulation created by actual firefighters.

No random gestures or unrealistic mechanics here: every action is based on the real-life protocols used by French firefighters in the field.

Take charge of victims, assess their condition, perform the right actions at the right time, and manage your action points to be as efficient as possible.
At the end of each mission, the game offers a detailed debriefing to help you improve your reflexes and deepen your knowledge.

Pompiers Simulator is mostly played using the mouse to interract with pictures. Through a clear and intuitive interface, you can talk with the victim, perform assessments, track vital signs, and of course carry out life-saving procedures—just like firefighters do every day.

TALK TO THE VICTIM

When the victim is conscious, you can ask them questions. These interactions help you understand what happened, identify possible pain, discomfort, or symptoms, and tailor your response.
Choosing the right questions allows you to complete a more accurate assessment, guide your actions, and avoid wasting valuable time or action points.

PATIENT ASSESSMENT

Measure the victim’s vital signs to evaluate their condition. Adapt your assessment based on your observations and stay alert for warning signs of life-threatening emergencies.
Your ability to interpret these indicators will be essential to prioritize your actions, make the right decisions, and operate efficiently in the field.

LIFE-SAVING ACTIONS

Perform the most appropriate rescue gestures for the situation—every action counts.
Learn to prioritize emergencies, manage your action points strategically, and ensure the victim is treated in the best possible conditions, while avoiding unnecessary or ineffective actions.

Immersive Simulation

Follow precise and realistic emergency protocols, and experience cardiopulmonary resuscitation as close to real life as possible.

Adventure Mode

Learn every step of first aid, progress from level to level to improve your skills and knowledge, face increasingly complex situations, and complete a variety of rescue missions.

🔥 Key Features

  • Realistic interventions based on real-world emergency care protocols used by firefighters on the field.

  • Strategic gameplay mechanics: every action costs points. Make the right choices to optimize your intervention.

  • Detailed debriefing system: analyze your decisions and improve your performance after each mission.

  • A variety of emergency scenarios: fainting, falls, unconsciousness, cardiac arrest... each mission presents new challenges.

  • Accessible simulation: no need to be a firefighter to learn life-saving gestures and understand emergency logic.

  • Educational resources: learn why each action or protocol is applied depending on the situation.

⚠️ SENSITIVE CONTENT WARNING

This game aims to portray the firefighter profession as realistically and respectfully as possible, with an educational approach.
As such, some scenarios include depictions of injuries, unconsciousness, acts of violence, suicide, psychological distress, or critical medical situations.
These scenes may be distressing, and it is not recommended to play Pompiers Simulator if you feel that any of these situations could affect your mental well-being.

🧪 EARLY ACCESS

The game is actively and regularly updated, with the goal of adding new tools and simulation features that bring it even closer to real-life practice.
We also plan to expand the game progressively with new missions and types of interventions, based on feedback from the community.

Our goal: to evolve Pompiers Simulator into a complete and educational simulation of the wide range of missions carried out by firefighters.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support, Direct3D 12 (12_0 feature level) support (Windows)
  • Storage: 2000 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 support, with 4 physical cores or more, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full Vulkan 1.2 support or Direct3D 12 (12_0 feature level) support (Windows)
  • Storage: 2000 MB available space
